import cpp

from ArrayExpr ae, AssignExpr asg
where
  asg.getLValue() = ae and
  ae.getArray().toString() = "buf" and
  ae.getIndex().toString() = "len" and
  asg.getRValue().toString() = "0"
select ae, "Potential out-of-bounds null-termination: write to buf[len] without proving len < allocated size."

import cpp

from ArrayExpr ae, AssignExpr asg
where
  asg.getLValue() = ae and
  ae.getArrayBase().toString() = "buf" and
  ae.getArrayOffset().toString() = "len" and
  asg.getRValue() instanceof IntLiteral and
  asg.getRValue().(IntLiteral).getValue() = "0"
select ae, "Write to buf[len] (null-termination) - review bounds: ensure len < size when buf was allocated/reallocated."

  asg.getRValue().toString() = "0"
select ae, "Null-termination write to buf[len] detected; verify len < allocated size."
